meta.purpose: Pronunciation brief for narration. 'spoken' is what is given to the speech engine (or to a human narrator as a guide). It changes only how a word is voiced; the transcript always shows the article's own spelling.
meta.verification: Phonemes were read back from the engine (scripts/listening-room/phones.py). Nobody has listened to the recording yet, so every entry needs a human ear before any narration is approved.

rules.why: The engine says a single word, 'eye', for 'AI'. Letters are spoken separately.
